# Conversation Follow-up

Find conversations worth continuing and draft the next step.

Use for finding conversations worth continuing and drafting the next message. Not for reading one conversation they link.

**The user might say:** "Find recent conversations worth continuing and draft my next message for each. Do not send anything."

## Steps

1. Recent mentions and replies.
   ```sh
   xholic mentions list --kind ALL
   ```
2. People worth answering now.
   ```sh
   xholic engage who-to-engage --limit 15
   ```
3. Read the ones worth continuing.
   ```sh
   xholic posts conversation --tweet-id <id>
   ```
4. Draft the next message for each. Send nothing.
